how.title: How to order?
how.subtitle: You only pay for the appliance once you see it. The only thing you transfer upfront is the delivery fee.

choose.title: Pick your product
choose.body: Browse and compare. Not sure? Ask us on WhatsApp and we'll recommend the right one.

confirm.title: Confirm the order
confirm.body: Leave your name, number and address, pick your area and see the delivery fee right away.

transfer.title: Transfer the delivery fee
transfer.body: Via InstaPay or Vodafone Cash, then send the receipt on WhatsApp in one tap.

receive.title: Receive and pay
receive.body: Our driver delivers, you inspect the appliance and pay for it in cash.

about.showroomNote: Mansoura · A complete home appliances and houseware destination since 1972
about.today: Today we bring the showroom's decades of experience to a fast, modern online store, so you can choose and order from home with confidence.

start.title: The start in Mansoura

wholesale.body: Became a main distributor for major factories, supplying showrooms across the Delta.

agents.title: Major agent partnerships
agents.body: Central warehouses expanded and a network of more than 500 traders and showrooms.

online.title: The online store
online.body: The same trust, with a modern way to shop from home.
